PARTIAL (high)

The analytically checkable sharp-interface Born/SAS energy reproduces exactly, supporting the paper’s physical constants and baseline energy bookkeeping. The paper’s central Table 1 claim—regularization yields a grid-independent limit while the trilinear approach remains grid-dependent—replicates in the key qualitative sense, and the regularized energies converge close to the reported limits. However, there are nontrivial quantitative discrepancies at coarse grids and a small but persistent offset in the converged one-charge limit (~0.2–0.3 kcal/mol, ~0.3–0.5%), suggesting either minor implementation/parameterization differences or under-specified details in the paper. Large parts of the paper’s broader validation (protein/compound/complex tables) are not independently reproducible from the publication alone due to missing inputs and reference datasets.
